statements.status_notes:
Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm vulnerability in Legion of the Bouncy Castle Inc. BC-JAVA bcprov on all (core modules).
This vulnerability is associated with program files G3413CTRBlockCipher.
This issue affects BC-JAVA: from 1.59 before 1.80.2, from 1.81 before 1.81.1, from 1.82 before 1.84.
statements.impact_statement: Bouncy Castle BC-JAVA GOST 28147 CTR mode keystream reuse affects bcprov-jdk18on versions from 1.59 before 1.80.2, from 1.81 before 1.81.1, and from 1.82 before 1.84. Liquibase Secure distribution includes org.bouncycastle:bcprov-jdk18on:1.78.1 (core/liquibase-dist/src/main/archive/licenses/commercial/README.txt:1298), which is in the affected range. However, the vulnerable code path is not reachable from Liquibase code: focused greps across Java sources for G3413CTRBlockCipher, GOST28147, GOST, G3413, CTRBlockCipher, GOST28147Engine, and GOST28147ParameterSpec returned zero hits.

statements.status_notes: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.85, Lazy ASN.1 sequence forcing resets nesting-depth guard. This issue also affects Bouncy Castle for Java LTS before 2.73.12, and Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS (BC-FJA) before bc-fips 1.0.2.7 (1.0.X series), 2.0.2 (2.0.X series) and 2.1.3 (2.1.X series).
statements.impact_statement: Bouncy Castle lazy ASN.1 sequence forcing resets nesting-depth guard affects bcprov-jdk18on before 1.85. Liquibase Secure distribution includes org.bouncycastle:bcprov-jdk18on:1.78.1 (core/liquibase-dist/src/main/archive/licenses/commercial/README.txt:1141), which is in the affected range. However, grep for direct `import org.bouncycastle.` usage across Java sources returned zero hits, and focused greps for LazyEncodedSequence, ASN1StreamParser, ASN1InputStream, BERSequenceParser, DLSequenceParser, and LazyConstructionEnumeration also returned zero hits. The only Bouncy Castle usage in production code is Snowflake private-key loading through the shaded `net.snowflake.client.jdbc.internal.org.bouncycastle.*` namespace in pro/src/main/java/com/datical/liquibase/ext/util/SnowflakeProJdbcConnectionUtil.java:7, pro/src/main/java/com/datical/liquibase/ext/util/SnowflakeProJdbcConnectionUtil.java:55, pro/src/main/java/com/datical/liquibase/ext/util/SnowflakeProJdbcConnectionUtil.java:57, and pro/src/main/java/com/datical/liquibase/ext/util/SnowflakeProJdbcConnectionUtil.java:73, which is a different package namespace than the standalone bcprov-jdk18on artifact reported by the scanner.

statements.status_notes:
Covert timing channel vulnerability in Legion of the Bouncy Castle Inc. BC-JAVA core on all (core modules). This vulnerability is associated with program files FrodoEngine.Java.
This issue affects BC-JAVA: from 1.71 before 1.84.
statements.impact_statement: Bouncy Castle BC-JAVA FrodoEngine covert timing channel affects versions 1.71 before 1.84. Liquibase Secure distribution includes org.bouncycastle:bcprov-jdk18on:1.78.1 (core/liquibase-dist/src/main/archive/licenses/commercial/README.txt:1318), but grep for FrodoEngine, Frodo, org.bouncycastle.pqc, pqc.crypto.frodo, and BCPQC across Java sources returned no matches, so the vulnerable Frodo post-quantum cryptography code path is not reachable.

statements.status_notes: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.85, Name Constraints bypass via trailing dot in rfc822Name and URI. This issue also affects Bouncy Castle for Java LTS before 2.73.12, and Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS (BC-FJA) before bc-fips 1.0.2.7 (1.0.X series), 2.0.2 (2.0.X series) and 2.1.3 (2.1.X series).
statements.impact_statement: Bouncy Castle Name Constraints bypass via trailing dot in rfc822Name and URI affects bcprov-jdk18on before 1.85. Liquibase Secure distribution includes org.bouncycastle:bcprov-jdk18on:1.78.1 (core/liquibase-dist/src/main/archive/licenses/commercial/README.txt:1141), which is in the affected range. However, grep for direct `import org.bouncycastle.` usage across Java sources returned zero hits, and focused greps for NameConstraints, rfc822Name, GeneralSubtree, and PKIXNameConstraintValidator also returned zero hits. The only Bouncy Castle usage in production code is Snowflake private-key loading through the shaded `net.snowflake.client.jdbc.internal.org.bouncycastle.*` namespace in pro/src/main/java/com/datical/liquibase/ext/util/SnowflakeProJdbcConnectionUtil.java:7, pro/src/main/java/com/datical/liquibase/ext/util/SnowflakeProJdbcConnectionUtil.java:55, pro/src/main/java/com/datical/liquibase/ext/util/SnowflakeProJdbcConnectionUtil.java:57, and pro/src/main/java/com/datical/liquibase/ext/util/SnowflakeProJdbcConnectionUtil.java:73, which does not exercise certificate name-constraint validation or the standalone bcprov-jdk18on classes reported by the scanner.
